title: A wonderful day in Spain!!!
text: We had the best time on this tour.  Communication was wonderful, we got picked up on time right from our hotel and then made one more stop to pick up another two couples.  So a total of six people.  Our driver was Alex and he was excellent - he filled the day with so many stories and interesting facts.  He would drop off of in certain areas, so that we could explore at our own pace and was ready and waiting to pick us up afterwards. title: Fun and interesting excursion
text: Was a fun way to see areas outside Barcelona! Great experience!
author: jojocop

title: Wonderful and educational.
text: We thoroughly loved, loved this tour.  They picked us up from the port, which made it so easy to tour without any worries.  The guide, Marta was warm friendly and very knowledgeable.  The driver was a pro at getting safely around mountain roads. This was an 8 hour day but felt like much less time.  They even paid for our taxi into the Gothic Quarter hotel after we were done.
author: JeanetteS468

title: Highly recommend Barcelona Day Tours
text: We used Barcelona Day Tours for a day tour of Barcelona & Montserrat following our transatlantic cruise and were very satisfied with the service. They picked us up right at the port as soon as we disembarked. We packed our luggage into the van and we were off. The van was clean, spacious and comfortable, offering enough room for the luggage of our small group of 14 people. Our guide was very engaging, and gave us plenty of information about the places, we visited or drove by. title: A perfect half day tour with an amazing tour guide
text:
We had a fantastic time on the tour. Pick up and drop off was easy, the tour vehicle was top of the line.
Our tour guide Magdellina was phenomenal. Our tour was all the more pleasant because of her knowledge and experience. Richard our driver was very helpful and added to the pleasant experience. I would highly recommend this trip.
author: Minakshi B

title: Wonderful Day!!!!!
text: This was a wonderful tour! Martha was great. We had the best day. We were picked up from the Ship and dropped off at the end of the day at our hotels. We had plenty of time to look around at each stop and take picture. Each stop was amazing and beautiful.
author: apriln496

title: Great tour
text: Hotel pick up as on time. The driver was friendly and knowledgeable. All stops on the tour were well worth going to. I highly recommend adding the skip the line tickets.
author: williamp539

title: Fantastic tour in Barcelona!!
text: I booked an excursion with Barcelona Day Tours for my husband and myself to visit Montserrat and Barcelona. Marta was an incredible guide!!! So informative and educational!! I don't think there was a question she couldn't answer. It is obvious that she loves the country and takes the time to learn everything she can and then share it with others. We would choose this tour company over and over again!!
author: 791tabithaz

title: Love
text: Wonderful tour. We were picked up from our cruise port, toured Montserrat and high lights of Barcelona and dropped off at our hotel. Easy communication with organisers. Marta was educational and delightful, Enrique our driver was great too. Small group and ran efficiently. Great tour. Thank you
author: 367becm

title: Best 4 hours in Barcelona
text:
Great tour.  Guide was wonderful;  stopping for pictures & expanding on what we were seeing with his knowledge of history of the area and with stories.  He made the tour interesting and memorable.
Easy pick up at the Barcelona airport & drop off at the passenger cruise pier.  
If you have only a few hours this tour is the best way to see exciting Barcelona.
Thank you Barcelona Day Tours.
author: 256jtt
